name: ePayco
description: Reusable Drupal integration for the ePayco (Colombian/Latin American) payment provider: stores ePayco account credentials as config entities, wraps the ePayco PHP SDK and REST endpoints in a service, and can render standalone payment buttons. Commerce, API-operations and Business Rules integrations ship as submodules.
project_description:
ePayco integrates the ePayco payment provider (widely used in Colombia and Latin America) with Drupal. It is the continuation of the older "Commerce ePayco" project, restructured so the base module works with or without Drupal Commerce.

The base module stores one or more sets of ePayco account settings as configuration entities ("factories"), exposes a reusable service (epayco.handler) that wraps the ePayco PHP SDK and its REST endpoints (transaction lookup, reference lookup, PSE bank list, outbound checkout signature), fires a transaction-response event, and can build standalone "payment option" buttons for use outside Commerce (for example donation pages).

Optional submodules add Drupal Commerce off-site/on-page payment gateways (commerce_epayco), a POST endpoint to run ePayco SDK operations (epayco_api), and a Business Rules integration (epayco_business_rules).
